narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management claimed quarterly PAT reached Rs 19.5 billion in Q2 FY27, but reported PAT was Rs 21,537 crore.
Reported annual revenue grew from Rs 122,189 crore in Mar 2020 to Rs 348,615 crore in Mar 2026, confirming massive balance sheet expansion.
Rule-based observation notes profit lagging sales over 3 years (19.7% vs 26.9%), supporting the narrative of margin pressure.

bull: Annual PAT increased steadily from Rs 27,296 crore in Mar 2020 to Rs 79,219 crore in Mar 2026.
Operating cash flow reached Rs 113,506 crore and free cash flow reached Rs 110,144 crore in Mar 2026.
Debt-to-equity ratio improved from 1.6 in Mar 2024 down to 0.98 as of Sep 2026.
bear: Quarterly revenue growth slowed to 3.7% in Jun 2026 and 9.4% in Sep 2026 compared to historical quarters.
Profit has lagged sales over a 3-year period at 19.7% versus 26.9%, indicating persistent margin pressure.
PAT YoY growth slowed to 5.8% by Sep 2026 from 19.3% in Jun 2026.
